title: InitiatorState Zeroize impl does not reset completed flag
description:
File: crates/oscore/src/edhoc/initiator.rs
Line: 93
Function: Zeroize::zeroize for InitiatorState
Category: state-integrity

## Description
Zeroize impl does not reset completed flag to false. If poison() is called after completed = true is set (line 441) but before function returns (line 444 can fail), state ends up with completed=true but lifecycle=Failed. export_oscore all-zeros PRK check catches this, but the logic is fragile.

## Fix
Add self.completed = false to the Zeroize impl for InitiatorState
